title: Study of Pitavastatin in Elderly Patients With Primary Hypercholesterolemia or Combined Dyslipidemia

sections.abstract:
This is an open-label extension study of NK-104-306 (NCT00257686) for elderly patients with hypercholesterolemia or combined dyslipidemia.

Posted outcomes: Change From Baseline in LDL-C. timeframe=Baseline to 60 weeks. Pitavastatin 2 mg QD=-43.18 (±10.065); Pitavastatin 4 mg QD=-44.26 (±10.764)
